_comment: Row 344 transform control. This must report exactly one valid ESCAPED mutant: it restores M1's hard-coded /tmp implementation byte-for-byte while the selected node only sources the library. The escape proves M1's primary CAUGHT verdict is a behavioral target assertion rather than shell parse or source-load failure.
subject: transform-only control for capture prune target binding

mutants.label: TC1 restore hard-coded /tmp under a source-only control
mutants.new:
local d n=0
  while IFS= read -r d; do
    n=$((n + 1))
    if [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ]; then
      rm -rf -- "$d" "${d}.tar.gz"
      printf 'pruned %s\n' "$d"
    fi
  done <<EOF
$(find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name "$(basename "$glob")" -type d -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null \
    | sort -rn | cut -d' ' -f2-)
EOF
